notes: QUINT_HOME controls the backend cache; verify both archive and installed JAR SHA256.
TLC is embedded in the pinned Apalache JAR. Its runtime Version display is not a reliable release identifier.
Use a dedicated local server endpoint. --apalache-version does not verify an already running server.
The TypeScript simulation backend avoids a separate Rust evaluator download.
The JAR includes platform-specific Z3 native libraries; no separate system Z3 install is required.
